title: HTTP byte ranges for downloads
prompt: A download endpoint implements single HTTP byte ranges. The current handler uses Python slicing incorrectly: inclusive ends lose one byte and suffix ranges are treated as absolute offsets. Fix serve_range(data, header) in ranges.py. Return (status, body, content_range), support missing headers, open-ended and suffix ranges, clamp oversized ends, return 416 for unsatisfiable ranges, and reject malformed or multiple ranges. Run tests and validate.
